reproducedAt: 900x640 (final run); the pre-geometry-fix build gave identical results at 854x630 and 502x549

whyTheyDiffer: Committed Level 1 baseline (84.4 s / 7352, increment 2) was only reproducible at a 502x549 viewport: three.js generateUUID() draws Math.random during rendering (bone textures, program setup), and how much it draws depends on the viewport and frustum. Rendering now uses its own seeded stream (seed.js isolateRender), so seeded runs are independent of window size.

Caching prop geometries (characters.js) means fewer three.js constructors, each of which draws 4 Math.random values for its UUID, so the simulation stream shifts again. Mid-audit (render isolated, before the cache) Level 1 seed 3 was 96.32 s / 5807.
Increment 4 Level 2 seed 12 reference (175.95 s / 10675, watched) shifts for the same two reasons.
